goal: Set the free shipping threshold in currency minor units.
whyThisDefault: Both samples set the threshold to 1000 minor units.

effect.appliesTo: The starter uses the deployed threshold in estimates. The default quote resolver uses it once the shipping policy takes effect.
frozenOn: The order draft saves the quote's shipping terms when present.

runtime.reason: The starter supplies the threshold through commerceSettingsPort. To keep the threshold with the same quote helper, supply that port in a replacement resolver.

schema.description: assertConfig checks whole minor units from 0 through 2147483647.

goal: Customize validation and normalization of the postal code and phone on saved customer addresses.

absentMeans.description: The platform uses the standard normalization and validation for the supplied address policy.

whyThisDefault: Hosts can choose address formats required by their delivery integrations while preserving existing behavior by default.

frozenOn: Existing saved addresses and captured delivery destinations keep their stored values.

runtime.reason: The callbacks are executable host code.

goal: Support optional postal codes and address regions.

runtime.reason: The native address contract requires a postal code and has no region field.
The customer preferences contract has a fixed payment method vocabulary.
